policies.title: Marshall Islands citizens: outside foreign visitor-visa scope
policies.summary: The Immigration Act gives every citizen of the Republic a right to be in the Republic. The same-country ordinary-passport row is normalized as citizenship, rather than a foreign visitor route.
conditions: This same-country normalization does not decide a dual national's treatment when presenting a different passport, nor residence, work, special-document, clearance, or individual-admissibility treatment.
Citizens remain subject to border-recording procedures; that does not create a foreign visitor visa requirement.

policies.title: United States, Palau, and Federated States of Micronesia citizens: statutory visa exemption
policies.summary: The Immigration Act expressly exempts citizens of the United States, Palau, and the Federated States of Micronesia from the requirement to hold a visa. This ordinary-passport catalog normalization is visa_free, not an arrival-issued visa.
conditions: The Act's exemption applies to citizens, while ordinary passports are the catalog scope. It does not establish treatment for diplomatic, contractor, crew, work, residence, or other special routes.
The Act states that exempt persons remain subject to immigration clearance and may be refused an entry permit on the statutory eligibility grounds.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: 90-day visa exemption or waiver
policies.summary: The Division's linked summary expressly labels this named ordinary-passport cohort visa exempt/waived for 90 days from arrival. Its grouping label is not used to infer membership; only the directly enumerated passport codes are modeled.
conditions: The summary requires six months-plus passport validity after departure, confirmed onward travel, and necessary onward-country documents; it forbids extension, change of status, and employment.
The source's historical 'EU Member Countries' heading also expressly enumerates the United Kingdom. The direct enumeration, not that inaccurate heading, supports GB.
Taiwan is expressly written as Republic of China-Taiwan, ROC. The separately listed Guatemala row is not modeled because the same summary also puts Guatemala in its VOA table.

policies.title: Named ordinary passports: visa on arrival
policies.summary: The Division's linked summary expressly labels this directly named ordinary-passport cohort VISA ON ARRIVAL, for a 90-day stay from arrival and a waived fee.
conditions: The summary specifies ordinary passports, six months-plus passport validity after departure, confirmed onward travel, and needed onward-travel visas; it excludes extension, change of status, employment, study, and research.

The list is modeled only for its directly named ordinary-passport codes. It does not prove a route for an omitted nationality, special passport, diplomatic mission, crew, transit, work, residence, or individual admission case.
Guatemala is deliberately excluded because the same official summary also places it in the visa-exempt table, creating a direct unresolved conflict.

conflicts.explanation: The Division's current linked ordinary-passport summary places Tonga in the VISA ON ARRIVAL table, rather than the visa-exempt/waiver table.
The Division's current linked ordinary-passport summary expressly names St. Lucia in its VISA ON ARRIVAL table.
